questions.q: How does the blessing Aaron and his sons were to speak begin?
options: Yahweh bless you, and keep you
questions.evidence: Yahweh bless you, and keep you

questions.q: Over the tabernacle at night, what did the cloud look like?
questions.evidence: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony: and at evening it was over the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until morning

questions.q: When Israel craved meat, what did a wind from Yahweh bring from the sea?
questions.evidence: A wind from Yahweh went out and brought quails from the sea

questions.q: Who became leprous, white as snow, after speaking against Moses?
questions.evidence: and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow

questions.q: Which spy said, "Let's go up at once, and possess it"?
questions.evidence: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once, and possess it

questions.q: For how many years would Israel wander in the wilderness?
questions.evidence: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness

questions.q: What happened to Korah and the men who stood with him?
questions.evidence: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up, with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods

questions.q: Whose rod budded, blossomed and bore ripe almonds?
questions.evidence: and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds

questions.q: How many times did Moses strike the rock at Meribah?
questions.evidence: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly

questions.q: What did Moses set on a pole so that the bitten could look and live?
questions.evidence: Moses made a serpent of brass, and set it on the pole

questions.q: Whose donkey was given a voice to speak to him?
questions.evidence: Yahweh opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times

questions.q: On whom did Yahweh tell Moses to lay his hand, to lead after him?
questions.evidence: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him
